text: ® Increase salaries of instructors whose salary is over $100,000 by 3%, and all others receive a 5% raise © Write two update statements: update instructor set salary = salary * 1.03 where salary > 100000; update instructor set salary = salary * 1.05 where salary <= 100000; © The order is important (why?) « Can be done better using the case statement (next slide)
